the new stud lines of pigs of the breed Yorkshire have been formed on the genetic basis of the most productive animals of the initial genepool.

the application of methods of population selection in the breeding herd of the new line of pigs with the use of molecular genetic markers of the genes RYR1 and ESR has a positive impact on the growth and development and reproductive characteristics of pigs.
the use of population selection methods and DNA testing for genes markers in pigs breeding is effective and allows to form new breeding herds with high productive traits.

the evaluation of the productive and reproductive traits of pigs in the formation of new breeding herds using the methods of population selection, index selection and DNA-testing for genes RYR1 and IGF2, MUC 4, ESR.
the evaluation of productive traits in the process of forming breeding herds using the population selection and molecular genetics methods.
the creation of breeding herd of two stud lines of Belarus type of pigs of the Yorkshire breed.
